definition: BentoML packages ML models into production API services with batching, containerisation and GPU support.
details: Created by Chaoyu Yang in 2019; developed by BentoML, Inc.

explainer.lead: How to install BentoML, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.inAi: Turn a notebook model into a scalable service with adaptive batching, then build a Docker image with one command.
explainer.jsNote: BentoML is a Python library with no official JavaScript or TypeScript package; call it from a Python service if your app is written in JavaScript.
